analysis.summary: The PR contains a high-severity null-pointer risk in the BFF error handler and includes a significant global configuration change that is out of scope for the stated intent.

bugs.title: PR Scope Violation: Unrelated global logic change
bugs.description: The PR title 'fix: update discount' suggests changes related to pricing/discounts. However, it includes a modification to the global 'preview' logic in the app integrator, flipping the logic from '=== false' to '=== true'.
bugs.risk: This change affects the environment configuration (preview vs. production content) for the entire shopping cart feature, not just discounts. Such a global architectural change is out of scope and high-risk if not intentionally coordinated across all teams.

bugs.title: Potential crash in bffErrorHandling due to unsafe property access
bugs.description: In the 'Unknown API Error' fallback path, the code attempts to access and delete 'error.config' without verifying that 'error' is an object. If the error handler is called with a null or undefined error (e.g., from a promise rejection reason), it will throw a TypeError.
bugs.risk: A crash inside an error handler is high severity as it turns a manageable error state into an unhandled exception, potentially crashing the BFF process or resulting in a failed request without a proper 500 response.

notBugs.reason: The addition of a salesChannel check for the showroom channel is consistent with the PR title 'update discount' and appears to be a deliberate business requirement to hide discounts in that specific channel.

The removal of the config property from detailedErrorData is likely a security measure to prevent sensitive Axios configuration (like auth headers) from being returned to the client in the error body.
